input.descriptionHtml:
A two-piece kit for smoother-looking, more manageable hair: Vilvah's Anti-Frizz Hair Serum 30ml and a neem wood comb with a handle.

In this kit

  • Anti-Frizz Hair Serum 30ml – a silicone-free serum with black seed, curry leaf, hibiscus and arnica oils that helps tame frizz and flyaways and adds shine.
  • Neem wood comb with handle – a smooth wooden comb that glides through hair with less static than plastic.

How to use

Warm 2–3 drops of serum between your palms and smooth over the lengths and ends of damp or dry hair, then comb through with the neem comb. Patch test before first use.

input.descriptionHtml:
The larger version of Vilvah's Face Brightening Kit: the Milk Powder Face Wash and the full-size Milk Drops Serum 40ml, for a simple cleanse-then-serum routine for dull-looking skin.

In this kit

  • Milk Powder Face Wash – a powder-to-foam cleanser with a rice complex, hyaluronic acid and papain that lathers with water and leaves skin feeling clean and soft.
  • Milk Drops Serum 40ml – a lightweight serum with rice milk extract, aloe vera and hyaluronic acid for hydrated, radiant-looking skin.

How to use

Morning and evening: mix a little face wash powder with water in your palm, massage onto damp skin and rinse. Then pat 2–3 drops of serum onto clean skin. Patch test before first use.

title: Vilvah Foot Cream & Body Lotion Kit

input.descriptionHtml:
A body-care pair for dry skin from head to toe: Vilvah's Foot Care Cream 100ml and Milk Body Lotion 250ml.

In this kit

  • Foot Care Cream 100ml – a rich cream with shea, mango and avocado butters plus argan and kalonji oils that softens dry, rough-feeling feet.
  • Milk Body Lotion 250ml – a fast-absorbing lotion with oat milk, ceramide, olive squalane and jojoba oil for everyday hydration.

How to use

Smooth the body lotion over skin after a bath or shower. Massage the foot cream into clean, dry feet, ideally before bed. Patch test before first use.
